# Library

A gallery of runnable examples for McRogueFace: bite-sized **playground snippets**, full **engine demo screens**, and **games**. Snippet links open the code straight in the playground; demo/game source links are pinned to a specific commit.

<sub>Short snippets carry their source inline in the link; longer ones load the raw file pinned to engine `77dd0fc` ([jmccardle/McRogueFace](https://github.com/jmccardle/McRogueFace)). Demos/games pinned to engine `0.2.8`. Generated by `tools/build_library.py`.</sub>

## Playground Snippets

282 focused, copy-paste examples covering the whole `mcrfpy` API. Each snippet fills the 1024x768 playground canvas.

> **Open in Playground** opens the exact code shown here in the [playground]({{ site.baseurl }}/playground/) &mdash; press Run (Ctrl+Enter). Short snippets travel inline in the URL (LZString-compressed `#src=`); longer ones load the raw file from the pinned commit (`#url=`). No copy-paste either way.
